skill.name: hig-inputs
skill.description: Review Apple platform input designs using Human Interface Guidelines for gestures, keyboards, pointers, Pencil, controllers, spatial input, and device controls.
skill.summary: Create platform-aware input recommendations for Apple applications.
skill.author: sickn33

security_audit.summary: All 64 static findings are false positives caused by Markdown paths, documentation links, screenshots, and Apple HIG terminology. The skill contains design guidance only; no command execution, upload behavior, reconnaissance, exfiltration, or prompt injection was found.

content.value_statement: Apple applications must support different input methods without breaking platform conventions or accessibility. This skill produces focused recommendations based on Apple Human Interface Guidelines.
actual_capabilities: Recommends suitable input methods for iOS, iPadOS, macOS, watchOS, tvOS, and visionOS.
Defines expected behavior for standard and custom gestures.
Suggests keyboard shortcuts, focus movement, and pointer interactions that follow platform conventions.
Covers Apple Pencil, Digital Crown, remotes, game controllers, motion sensors, nearby interaction, and Camera Control.
Provides accessibility alternatives for interactions that depend on a specific device or physical action.
Organizes results into platform recommendations, gesture specifications, keyboard guidance, and accessibility alternatives.
limitations: The skill provides design guidance and does not implement or test application code.
The bundled references may not include later changes to Apple guidance or platform capabilities.
Recommendations depend on accurate details about target platforms, tasks, and supported devices.
Device testing and review with assistive technologies remain necessary.

use_cases.title: Plan Cross-Platform Inputs
use_cases.description: Map touch, keyboard, pointer, Pencil, and controller support across an Apple application.

use_cases.title: Review Interaction Specifications
use_cases.description: Check gestures, focus behavior, shortcuts, and feedback before implementation.

use_cases.title: Audit Accessible Alternatives
use_cases.description: Identify tasks that require alternate controls for different devices, abilities, or interaction modes.

prompt_templates.title: Review One Interaction
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this interaction for [platform]: [interaction]. Recommend the expected input behavior, feedback, and one accessible alternative.
prompt_templates.scenario: A beginner needs guidance for a single control or gesture.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Platform Inputs
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare input requirements for [feature] on [platforms]. Cover primary inputs, keyboard or pointer support, feedback, and platform-specific constraints.
prompt_templates.scenario: A team is adapting one feature across Apple platforms.

prompt_templates.title: Create an Input Specification
prompt_templates.prompt: Create an input specification for [product flow]. Include platform recommendations, a gesture table, keyboard shortcuts, focus behavior, and accessibility alternatives.
prompt_templates.scenario: A designer needs an implementation-ready interaction specification.

prompt_templates.title: Audit a Complex Input System
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit this input design: [design details]. Find convention conflicts, inaccessible dependencies, destructive actions, discoverability gaps, and device-specific failures. Prioritize fixes by user impact.
prompt_templates.scenario: An experienced team needs a detailed review before release.

output_examples.input: Review zoom controls for an iPad drawing application that supports touch, trackpad, and Apple Pencil.
output: Use pinch to zoom with touch and trackpad.
Keep Pencil input dedicated to drawing unless the user selects another tool.
Provide visible zoom controls and keyboard shortcuts as alternatives.
Preserve the zoom focal point and show immediate visual feedback.

output_examples.input: Recommend navigation inputs for a media application on tvOS and visionOS.
output: Use predictable focus movement and a clear focus indicator on both platforms.
Support the Siri Remote clickpad and Back button conventions on tvOS.
Use look and pinch with generous targets on visionOS.
Avoid sustained gaze activation and provide an alternate way to complete every task.

best_practices: State the target platforms, supported devices, and primary user tasks.
Describe custom gestures and destructive actions so the review can assess discoverability and recovery.
Validate recommendations on physical devices with keyboard, pointer, and assistive technologies.
anti_patterns: Do not request one universal interaction model without identifying platform differences.
Do not make custom gestures the only way to complete an essential task.
Do not treat guidance as proof that an interaction works on every device or accessibility configuration.

faq.question: Which Apple platforms does this skill cover?
faq.answer: It covers iOS, iPadOS, macOS, watchOS, tvOS, and visionOS input considerations.

faq.question: Can it generate application code?
faq.answer: No. It produces design recommendations and specifications, but it does not implement or test code.

faq.question: Does it support accessibility reviews?
faq.answer: Yes. It can identify missing alternatives and recommend support for keyboard, focus, VoiceOver, Switch Control, and other inputs.

faq.question: Can it review custom gestures?
faq.answer: Yes. Provide each gesture, its purpose, target platforms, feedback, and fallback controls.

faq.question: Does it replace current Apple documentation?
faq.answer: No. Verify release-sensitive details against current Apple documentation and platform testing.

faq.question: What context produces the best results?
faq.answer: Provide platforms, devices, user tasks, existing interactions, accessibility needs, and any destructive or time-sensitive actions.
